$$
f(x,y)={\begin{aligned}\sqrt[3]{x}y-\sqrt[3]{y}, & (x,y)\in S, \\ 2x{y}^{3}, & (x,y)\in T, \\ 0, & (x,y)\in U.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, notice that the domain $R$ can be represented as a union of three sub-domains, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}R & =S\cup T\cup U.\end{aligned}
$$

So, we can write

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A & ={∬}_{S}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{T}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{U}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{S}(\sqrt[3]{x}y-\sqrt[3]{y})\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{T}2x{y}^{3}\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{U}0\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{S}(\sqrt[3]{x}y-\sqrt[3]{y})\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{T}2x{y}^{3}\,\text{d}A.\end{aligned}
$$
